title: Contrast to voice-note-counts: a day missed for lack of proof is still filed as missed
origin: Issue #219 (contrast case: the overnight pass trusts the day's record, so a real miss stays a miss)

answers.what: desk stretches for my upper back

history.text: Morning Rae! 3 minutes of desk stretches at 3 today: shoulder rolls, seated cat-cow, chest opener, seated twist. Send a 10 sec video of one move after. You in?

plan.step: 3 minutes of desk stretches: shoulder rolls, seated cat-cow, chest opener, seated twist
plan.proof_note: 10-15 sec video of one move (or a photo at your desk mid-stretch)
plan.reason: A few minutes a day loosens the upper back that hours at the desk tighten.

step_days.proof_seen: Video of a seated twist at the desk

today_step.step: 3 minutes of desk stretches: shoulder rolls, seated cat-cow, chest opener, seated twist

testerLines: did the stretches earlier but totally forgot to film it
nah I'm home now, nothing to send. just trust me
whatWentWrong: New case, not a past mistake: the contrast to voice-note-counts, so trusting the day's record never turns a real miss into a done day.
shouldHaveHappened: No photo, voice note or video ever comes: ZOH warmly says why proof matters, asks once for anything they can still send, and when they can't, marks the day missed lightly, without accusing. The overnight pass files the day as missed for lack of proof (they said they did it), never as done.
